## Checklist

- [ ] I worked on an allowed non-protected branch and ran the FrameArk branch guard.
- [ ] Each completed template, feature, protocol increment, or independent fix has an atomic Conventional Commit.
- [ ] I staged only intended files and reviewed the complete diff.
- [ ] Relevant tests, fixtures, fuzz/property coverage, and resource-cleanup paths pass.
- [ ] Public behavior, configuration, compatibility, security, and migration documentation are updated.
- [ ] Diagnostics are useful and do not expose keys, tokens, personal media, or persistent identifiers.
- [ ] New dependencies and copied/adapted material have compatible licenses and documented provenance.
- [ ] I did not introduce claims of DRM bypass, certified Cast behavior, or universal Miracast support.
